name: No Right Answers
source:
"No Right Answers" is a psychological romance visual novel where you spend six days trapped in an interrogation room at the edge of the world — facing someone who might fall in love with you… or pull the trigger. 

[From [url=https://drunk-mantis.itch.io/no-right-answer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《没有正确答案》是一部心理浪漫视觉小说，你将在世界边缘的一间审讯室里度过六天的时间，面对一个可能会爱上你……或扣动扳机的人。

[来自[url=https://drunk-mantis.itch.io/no-right-answer]itch.io[/url]]
